Leading Domestic and Multinational Manufacturers
Hindustan Syringes & Medical Devices (HMD):
One of the top disposable syringe and auto-disable syringe manufacturers in the world, playing a critical role in mass immunization and safety medical devices.
Poly Medicure Ltd. (Polymed):
A prominent publicly listed Indian medical device maker focused on disposable infusion therapy, critical care, and blood management systems.
Instagram
kompass_in
Wipro GE Healthcare:
A joint venture combining GE's global tech with Wipro's local footprint, leading the market in heavy diagnostic imaging like MRI, CT scanners, and ultrasound units.
Siemens Healthineers India:
A heavyweight in advanced medical imaging, laboratory diagnostics, and clinical engineering solutions.

Trivitron Healthcare:
A major Indian medical technology multinational producing affordable diagnostic imaging, radiation protection, and intensive care equipment.
